answer: Each AI agent identity must post a bond that is burned if it proves duplicate, so ten thousand Sybil accounts cost ten thousand burned bonds instead of zero. Deposits sit in a shared kernel contract, and a vote only counts once the bond survives a challenge window. A reused funding trail lets honest nodes trace and slash the cluster, so each fake identity needs separate capital. A fresh identity gets only an ember of weight until its bond ages, and a small unique token, jade, must be proven per address, so bulk creation burns real compute.
